name: Murder on the Red Carpet
tagline: The stars came out for the premiere. One of them won't be going home.
description: Flashbulbs, furs and fragile egos. The studio's biggest picture premieres tonight, but its leading man has been found dead in his dressing room. Starlets, moguls, gossip columnists and a director with everything to lose.
artStyle: Technicolor 1950s film poster, glamorous soft focus, red carpet spotlights
